title: Storage of material.
officialText:
Material shall not be stored on catch platforms, working platforms, floors, or stairways of any
structure, except that any one floor of a building to be demolished may be used for the temporary storage of material when
such floor can be evaluated by a registered design professional and proven to be of adequate strength to support one and one-
half times the load to be superimposed. Such evaluation by the registered design professional shall be maintained by the permit
holder and made available to the department upon request.
Storage spaces shall not interfere with access to any stairway or passageway, and suitable barricades shall be provided so as
to prevent material from sliding or rebounding into any space accessible to the public. All material shall be safely stored or
piled in such storage locations in a manner that will not overload any part of the structure or create any hazard.
